comingLast.roast: tied with Nash - the blue balls love a countback drama
needs 4 points - the field says good luck, the bar says stay put
still swinging on 13 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
needs 4 in 3 - the kind of chase the bar was built for
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
6 holes for a jailbreak - 2 points cuts the wire
4 holes to change the story - the current draft ends at the presso table
all square with May at the bottom - somebody has to blink (or wipe)
above May by 1 - close enough to hear the engraver
1 above the cellar door with 5 to play - just keep scoring
